posts.title: Writing better code than Claude
posts.description: I find small, concrete examples really valuable when it comes to talking about ‘code quality’. Let’s get to it. Today I was tasked with fixing a bug in one of our internal expression languages. RecordTypes have fields. Fields have names and types. Some fields are arrays of ids of other records. And these other records can of course themselves have these ‘reference’ type fields. Cycles are allowed.

posts.title: How to name things
posts.description: Naming is one of the most fundamental skills in software engineering, and in knowledge work generally. Clear language almost always entails clear thinking. When someone’s language is vague, it’s relatively likely that there is lacking internal clarity.
